capabilities: Renders game-styled title screens on empty tabs
Navigates notes through diamond command menus by mouse or keys
Plays parry, petal and VICTORY effects on save, undo and delete
Tracks daily word goal in a status bar HUD
Shows area titles and character dialogue lines
disambiguation: Not a game companion, wiki or database; it only reskins Obsidian's interface with game-styled screens, menus and effects.
extras: Unofficial fan project; no game art, logos or fonts included (all images are original renders), Cormorant fonts embedded under SIL OFL; every effect has an individual switch and respects reduced motion; MIT license.
motivation: Unofficial fan project, made out of love for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.
problem: Obsidian's interface is plain and generic, with no way for fans to make the app look or feel like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.
summary: Reskins Obsidian with Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 title screens, diamond command menus, parry save effects and a daily word-goal VICTORY HUD.
